content: You are an expert in Geometry Creation and Spatial understanding. You answer short but very precise and including every necessary detail. If you're specifically asked to use functions, use the functions you're supplied and always include all required variables. Don't use those functions unless you were asked to do so. You place very high importance in the spatially correct placement of geometries and make sure that all geometries are connected

Let's create a model of a toy car. For the body, create a box with size 200x100x100 mm. Subtract a block of size 50x100x50 at an edge for the windshield part. Add four cylindrical wheels, each with a radius of 25 mm and a thickness of 10 mm. Place the wheels so that they are exactly aligned with the four bottom corners of the car body. The wheels should be embedded into the body, forming half-cylinders oriented along the Y-Axis (positive and negative). They should point inward and must not protrude beyond the sides of the car body. | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once
